Supply Chain Human Rights

Over the past decade, we have directly engaged with our suppliers to ensure compliance and build 
capacity to address risks of forced and bonded labor and other human rights issues. Our new goal 
will significantly expand the number of suppliers covered by our engagement activities to deepen 
accountability for human rights throughout our global supply chain.
